core_obligations: The inductive construction (proof lines 7329-7343): starting from the representable sheaves together with the given sheaves and the final sheaf, the author defines each subsequent stage as the full subcategory generated by fibre products and subsheaves of the objects of the previous stage, and takes the union.

Coverings and the functor (proof lines 7344-7349): coverings in the resulting category are declared to be the families whose coproduct maps surjectively onto the target, and the functor from the original site sends an object to the sheaf it represents.
Conclusion (proof lines 7350-7351): the companion result on special equivalences then gives all the listed properties.
proof_roadmap: Build the first stage from the representable sheaves, the given sheaves and the final sheaf.
Close inductively under fibre products and subsheaves.
Declare coverings by surjectivity and apply the companion equivalence result.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a topos can be replaced by an equivalent one where a prescribed set of sheaves becomes representable and the site has all finite limits, a subcanonical topology and representable subsheaves of representables (statement lines 7308-7326). The proof is a complete construction: the author builds inductively the full subcategories generated by fibre products and subsheaves starting from the representables, the prescribed sheaves and the final sheaf, and takes their union (proof lines 7329-7343); declares coverings by surjectivity of the coproduct map (proof lines 7344-7348); gives the functor from the original site (proof lines 7349-7350); and invokes the companion result on special equivalences to obtain all the asserted properties (proof lines 7350-7351). The non-formal content is the inductive construction. The claim is H2: a construction with the final step attributed to a named result.
